chatgpt_planning.name: ChatGPT planning / advisory
chatgpt_planning.body:
## Context
I work in IT backend/system administration. {TASK}

## What I need from you
- Recommend an approach with trade-offs.
- List risks, prerequisites, and open questions.
- Produce a step-by-step plan I can hand to an execution agent.

## Constraints
{CONSTRAINTS}

## Output format
1. Recommended approach (short)
2. Plan (numbered steps)
3. Risks and rollback considerations
4. Verification checklist

jira_ticket.name: Jira ticket drafting
jira_ticket.body:
Draft a Jira ticket for the following work. {TASK}

Include:
- Summary (one line)
- Description with background/context
- Acceptance criteria (testable bullet points)
- Validation steps and evidence to attach
- Suggested labels/components

Keep wording clear and free of jargon. Constraints: {CONSTRAINTS}

atlassian_docs.name: Atlassian / Confluence documentation
atlassian_docs.body:
Write internal Confluence documentation for: {TASK}

Structure:
- Purpose (2-3 sentences)
- Audience
- Prerequisites
- Step-by-step instructions with expected results
- Troubleshooting / common failure points
- Rollback or undo steps
- Owner and review date

Style: plain language, numbered steps, short paragraphs. Constraints: {CONSTRAINTS}

workspace_agent.name: ChatGPT workspace agent design
workspace_agent.body:
Design a ChatGPT workspace agent. {TASK}

The agent definition must include:
- Purpose and scope (what it does and does NOT do)
- Allowed tools and forbidden actions
- Memory/context strategy (memory is supplemental — durable source-of-truth files win)
- Self-learning as local reflection notes, not uncontrolled autonomy
- Instruction-bloat control: review and slim instructions regularly
- Harness/task-contract workflow (scope, inputs, tools, constraints, outputs, verification)
- Verification requirements before claiming completion
- Handoff behavior when work remains

Constraints: {CONSTRAINTS}

harness_setup.name: Harness / project setup
harness_setup.body:
Set up a working harness for this project. {TASK}

Create:
- AGENTS.md with orientation, conventions, and constraints
- A task-contract template (scope, inputs, tools, constraints, outputs, verification)
- An evidence/handoff convention

Working loop to encode:
1. Orient from nearest AGENTS.md
2. Load smallest relevant files
3. Define bounded task contract
4. Execute one coherent slice
5. Capture evidence
6. Update durable files
7. Verify before claiming completion
8. Leave a handoff

Local files are the source of truth; external systems (Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, etc.) are downstream copies.

Constraints: {CONSTRAINTS}
